_comment: d1 #247 FoTI EXTENSION canonical (inn_guests_ext_loop) fixture: the parent of the four new roster members' only live coverage. Built off inn_guests_full_start, which it leaves untouched (never mutate a shared snapshot). Delta: the four new met counters (chatted_with_klbkch/_rags/_wilovan/_grimalkin) plus the THREE QUEST TERMINALS the new rows gate on -- rags_meeting_settled, brothers_job_done, elevator_pass_stamped -- and each terminal's own earlier beats, so this is a real story position and not three flags in a vacuum (chieftains_price settled on the SUPPLY path, a_gentlemans_disagreement closed by exposing Coyle, forge_tier_permit stamped). The travel chain comes with them, because you cannot have closed a job in Invrisil or filed a permit in Pallass without having reached either city: riverfarm_attuned -> blight_lifted -> invrisil_attuned (plus the two attunement stones in inventory, which are never removable) and pallass_attuned. test_fixture_coherence enforces every link of that; the fixture was written twice before it agreed. price_of_a_favor_reported and seal_kept_reported are DELIBERATELY still unbanked so acts.json keeps this save in the same act as its parent -- the subject here is the guest window, not act progression. times_slept 16, not 10: with all TEN rostered met and every gate banked the pool is 10, so start = 16%10 = 6 and the window seats KLBKCH (11,5) + RAGS (12,5). Sleeping walks it forward through rags+wilovan (12,6) at 17 to wilovan+grimalkin (14,5) at 18, which is every one of the four new registers in three wakings. Boot cell (12,3) is plain floor two rows north of Rags's chair: (12,4) would have worked mechanically, but it stacks the player's own sprite directly behind hers and makes the boot FEEL shot unreadable.
